Detailed Description

Top-level application window and central controller for Sioyek.

Coordinates GUI input dispatch, document management, background MuPDF rendering, and the Vulkan presentation canvas.

Key responsibilities:

  • Event-Driven Render Readiness: When background MuPDF worker threads complete rasterizing visible pages, PdfRenderer::render_advance invokes invalidate_render(). This immediately resumes and answers waiting IPC commands and queries via advance_waiting_command() without periodic timer polling.
  • IPC Server & Scripting: Accepts Unix domain socket commands (e.g. from command line, scripts, or Neovim/LaTeX plugins), executes commands synchronously or asynchronously, and returns structured JSON or text responses.
  • Document Lifecycle: Manages opening, hashing, reloading, and caching of documents and their metadata across window splits and helper views.
  • Search Orchestration: Dispatches non-blocking regex and fuzzy searches to the worker thread and updates viewport match indicators.
